title: Undoing a plus or a minus

ask.text: Close it.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Grip the lip and walk it over the Sill. It turns around on the way.
The near pan was carrying a lip of 9. The far pan is holding 14.

worldFraming.text: Grip the lip, walk it over the Sill, set it down turned around.
